description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the MySQLBooleanType class, particularly its database type conversion and priority handling within the Liquibase framework.

classes.name: MySQLBooleanTypeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of MySQLBooleanType, including data type conversion for MySQL databases and prioritization relative to BooleanType.

methods.name: shouldReturnTinyIntForMySQLDatabase
methods.description: Tests that MySQLBooleanType converts to 'TINYINT(1)' when used with a MySQLDatabase.

methods.name: shouldDelegateToLiquibaseDatabases
methods.description: Tests that MySQLBooleanType correctly converts to the appropriate database data type across various database implementations, excluding certain subclasses.

methods.name: shouldHaveHigherPriority
methods.description: Verifies that MySQLBooleanType has a higher priority than the generic BooleanType.
